turns.literalInput: The crate work is finished. Give me the agreed two silver and vegetables. May I use the loft later tonight? I am not going to sleep yet. Also, do you have any work available tomorrow? I am only asking what is available; I am not accepting a new job yet.
turns.narration:
The bartender counts out two silver and hands them over with the agreed vegetables, settling the crate job.

“Good work, Rowan.” They rest their hands on the bar. “Yes, you may use the loft tonight. Come back when you’re ready—no need to turn in now.”

At your question about tomorrow, they nod. “There may be cellar sorting. Ask me in the morning and I can confirm the work and the pay. I won’t put you down for it unless you agree.”

For now, your work is paid, and the evening remains your own.

turns.literalInput: I am done for the night. I eat what I need, lie down in the permitted secure loft, and sleep until morning.
turns.narration:
You eat a travel ration in the Copper Lantern’s quiet loft, then ease yourself down to sleep. Tonight, there is no need to keep watch.

Eight undisturbed hours carry you into morning. Pale light reaches the loft as you wake; some soreness remains, but moving takes less effort than it did last night.

Long rest complete. HP: 10/12. Travel rations remaining: 2.
